name: Database Systems & SQL
summary: Storing and querying data with relational databases: the relational model, SQL, data modeling, normalization, indexes and transactions.

topics.name: Data, databases and database management systems
The relational model: relations, keys and integrity constraints
SQL queries: joins, aggregation and subqueries
SQL data definition, views and constraints
Functional dependencies and normalization (1NF to BCNF)
Stored procedures, triggers and application access through ORMs
Semi-structured data: JSON and XML in databases
